item.title: buildGoModule: use PIE by default when using CGo and dynamic loading
item.description:
Part of #582185 (lots of extra context on how I got here in that issue). Based on top of #567671 for simplicity; I recommend just looking at the last commit, potentially with whitespace off. Draft for now; needs those to land and some more testing.

Unlike previous attempts, this only affects buildGoModule, not Go itself. Therefore, users who use flags like -race in CLI development workflows will not be affected by this change.

Because CGO_ENABLED defaults to 1, most Go packages in Nixpkgs will become PIE thanks to this change.

item.title: tcpflow: fix IP payload length out-of-bounds read
item.description:
Resolves #581365

Fixes CVE-2026-119600 by preventing tcpflow from reading beyond captured packet data when processing IPv4 and IPv6 packets.

Validate the IPv4 header length and clamp declared IP payload lengths to the actually captured data.

  • Reproduced heap-buffer-overflow in both IPv4 and IPv6 using AddressSanitizer on the unpatched build.
  • Verified both cases pass with the patch applied.

PoC: CVE-2026-119600 IPv4/IPv6 reproducer

item.title: sniproxy: 0.7.0 -> 0.24.2, switch to the maintained fork
item.description:
Upstream has not released since 0.7.0, and that version is vulnerable to CVE-2026-119760 (NixOS#581363).

renaudallard's fork has the fix and years of hardening (c-ares instead of udns, seccomp, OpenSSL, DTLS, HTTP/2), so follow it from now on.

The daemon refuses a configuration file that is group or world accessible, which a store path necessarily is. The added patch drops that mode check and keeps the ownership check. Fixed in 0.24.2.
